# Learning Voyage

Learning Voyage LLC is Owen Onderdonk's independent practice and publishing home for AI data, evaluation, research operations, data partnerships, proprietary-data systems, and agent environments.

## Owen Onderdonk

Owen is an AI Data & Evaluation Program Lead. He entered frontier-model data work in February 2024 through complex mathematics training-data creation, then progressed through contributor review, reviewer oversight, standards and calibration design, and into project development, program management, and broader operations. Selected work has included managing data and evaluation projects supporting a frontier AI lab through an external AI data partner.

## Flagship public work

AutoQA Foundation: https://autoqa-foundation.vercel.app/
Case study: https://learning.voyage/work/autoqa-foundation.html

AutoQA Foundation is an independent public decision and technical framework for LLM-based quality review. It distinguishes supported, contradicted, insufficient, and contract-ambiguous outcomes; separates task limits, model capability, and decision authority; and requires lane-level calibration, abstention, and named human ownership before automated findings receive consequential authority. It is not a certification body, formal standard, or accuracy claim for any particular system.
